# Runtime tier & capability gating in NeuralShell

There are **four separate gates** that often get conflated. They compose in the renderer but are resolved in different places.

---

## 1. Architecture overview

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph main [Main process - src/main.js]
    ENV["LICENSE_MODE env / NeuralShell.runtime.env"]
    LIC["active_license.json + licenseEngine"]
    RES["resolveRuntimeCapabilities()"]
    TIER["withRuntimeTier() → settings.tier"]
    ENV --> RES
    LIC --> RES
    RES --> IPC["settings:get → tierId, capabilities, licenseMode"]
    ENV --> TIER
  end
  subgraph renderer [Renderer - App.jsx]
    RT["runtimeTier: PREVIEW | OPERATOR | AUDITOR"]
    CAP["runtimeCapabilityPayload.tierId + capabilities[]"]
    AUD["auditOnly = runtimeTier === AUDITOR"]
    GTM["internalGtmMode localStorage"]
    ROLE["activeRuntimeRole localStorage"]
    IPC --> RT
    IPC --> CAP
    RT --> AUD
  end
```

| Layer | Values | What it controls |
|--------|--------|------------------|
| **Runtime tier** (`settings.tier` / `runtimeTier`) | `PREVIEW`, `OPERATOR`, `AUDITOR` | Badge label, **audit-only UI** (write lockdown) |
| **Plan tier** (`tierId`) | `free`, `pro`, `enterprise` | Capability list, ecosystem `minTier`, IPC feature gates |
| **License mode** (main only) | `preview`, `auditor`, `operator`, `enterprise` | Source for `resolveCapabilities()` |
| **Runtime role** (localStorage) | `founder`, `operator`, `support`, `security`, `sales` | Fleet/recovery/appliance **panel** access |
| **Internal GTM** (localStorage) | `0` / `1` | Hollow GTM consoles & entry points (default **off**) |

---

## 2. Key files

| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\main.js` | `LICENSE_MODE`, `resolveRuntimeCapabilities`, `withRuntimeTier`, license IPC, `proofRelay:*` capability checks |
| `C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\core\capabilities.js` | Maps license mode → `tierId` + capability list from `config/tiers.json` |
| `C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\config\tiers.json` | Canonical capability sets for `free` / `pro` / `enterprise` |
| `C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\config\plans.json` | Plan definitions for signed license blobs |
| `C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\billing\licenseEngine.js` | Sign/verify licenses; `planIdToLicenseMode()` |
| `C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\core\ipcValidators.js` | Validates persisted `settings.tier` ∈ `{PREVIEW, OPERATOR, AUDITOR}` |
| `C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\core\stateManager.js` | Default `tier: "PREVIEW"` |
| `C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\App.jsx` | `auditOnly`, tier badge unlock, GTM/role/demo localStorage |
| `C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\components\TopStatusBar.jsx` + `TierBadge.jsx` | Operator badge / unlock click |
| `C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\components\BillingCenter.jsx` | UI license blob activation |
| `C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\routes\ecosystem.ts` | Module access: role + `tierId` + capability |
| `C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\runtime\roles\roleCapabilities.ts` | Role-based panel permissions |
| `C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\scripts\generate_offline_license.cjs` | Dev license generation |

---

## 3. Main-process capability resolution (authoritative)

Priority in `resolveRuntimeCapabilities()`:

1. **`LICENSE_MODE` env** (if not `preview`) → `resolveCapabilities(forcedMode)` and **forces** `settings.tier` via `FORCED_RUNTIME_TIER`
2. **Signed license** at `{userData}/billing/active_license.json` (active/grace)
3. **`settings.licenseMode`** — read in code but **not** in `validateSettings()`, so it is **not persisted** via `settings:update`
4. Fallback → `preview` → **`free`** capabilities

```295:308:C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\main.js
function normalizeLicenseMode(value) {
  const raw = String(value || "").trim().toLowerCase();
  if (raw === "auditor" || raw === "audit") return "auditor";
  if (raw === "operator" || raw === "pro") return "operator";
  if (raw === "enterprise" || raw === "ent") return "enterprise";
  return "preview";
}

function forcedTierFromLicenseMode(mode) {
  if (mode === "auditor") return "AUDITOR";
  if (mode === "operator") return "OPERATOR";
  if (mode === "enterprise") return "OPERATOR";
  return null;
}
```

License mode → plan tier mapping in `capabilities.js`:

```18:22:C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\core\capabilities.js
function tierFromLicenseMode(licenseMode) {
  const mode = String(licenseMode || "").trim().toLowerCase();
  if (mode === "operator" || mode === "pro") return "pro";
  if (mode === "enterprise") return "enterprise";
  return "free";
}
```

**Production default:** enterprise installer writes `LICENSE_MODE=auditor` into `NeuralShell.runtime.env` (audit-only deploy baseline per `docs/deployment/enterprise.md`).

---

## 4. Renderer: audit-only vs operator UI

```700:703:C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\App.jsx
    const auditOnly = String(runtimeTier || '').toUpperCase() === 'AUDITOR';
    const capabilities = Array.isArray(runtimeCapabilityPayload.capabilities) ? runtimeCapabilityPayload.capabilities : [];
    const canUseOnboardingWizard = capabilities.includes('onboarding_wizard') || String(runtimeCapabilityPayload.tierId || '') === 'enterprise';
    const canUseIssueAssist = capabilities.includes('issue_assist');
```

- **`auditOnly`**: driven only by `runtimeTier === 'AUDITOR'` (session save, prompts, attachments, etc.).
- **Capabilities**: from `settings.get()` (`tierId`, `capabilities[]`) — main process, not the tier badge alone.

### Tier badge “unlock” (partial / UI-heavy)

```407:430:C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\App.jsx
    const handleTierUnlock = React.useCallback(async () => {
        // ...
        if (!(trimmed.startsWith('ns_op_') || trimmed === 'founder' || trimmed === 'test')) {
            showAppToast('Invalid license format.', 'error');
            return;
        }
        await window.api.settings.update({ tier: 'OPERATOR' });
        setRuntimeTier('OPERATOR');
        setRuntimeCapabilityPayload((prev) => ({
            ...prev,
            tierId: 'pro',
            tierLabel: 'Operator',
        }));
```

This sets **`settings.tier = OPERATOR`** and updates React state, but **does not** activate a license blob or set `LICENSE_MODE`. After `refreshRuntimeContext()`, capabilities still come from main unless env/license says otherwise. Treat this as a **UI shortcut**, not full enterprise unlock.

**Real license path:** Settings → Billing (`BillingCenter`) → `window.api.license.activateBlob`, or env override.

---

## 5. Environment variables

| Variable | Effect |
|----------|--------|
| **`LICENSE_MODE`** | `auditor` \| `operator` \| `enterprise` (aliases: `audit`, `pro`, `ent`) — **strongest** capability + tier override |
| **`NeuralShell.runtime.env`** | Loaded from cwd or beside exe (`loadRuntimeEnvOverrides`) — standard place for `LICENSE_MODE` |
| **`NS_ALLOW_DEV_LICENSE_KEY=1`** | Dev HMAC signing key for local license gen/verify |
| **`NS_LICENSE_SIGNING_KEY`** | Production signing key |
| **`NEURAL_USER_DATA_DIR`** | Isolated profile (E2E / portable testing) |
| **`NEURAL_IGNORE_INTEGRITY=1`** | Dev smoke/E2E |
| **`NEURAL_SMOKE_MODE=1`** | Smoke harness |

Deploy MSI uses `NEURAL_LICENSE_MODE` as an MSI property; **main reads `LICENSE_MODE`** (also accepted in `scripts/proofRelay.cjs` as fallback). Prefer **`LICENSE_MODE`** in `NeuralShell.runtime.env`.

---

## 6. Settings keys (persisted vs computed)

| Key | Persisted? | Notes |
|-----|------------|-------|
| **`settings.tier`** | Yes | `PREVIEW` \| `OPERATOR` \| `AUDITOR`; forced when `LICENSE_MODE` set |
| **`settings.tierId`**, **`tierLabel`**, **`capabilities`** | No (computed) | Injected in `settingsForRenderer()` |
| **`licenseMode`** | No (computed on get) | `resolveEffectiveLicenseMode()` |
| **`licenseStatus`** | No | From `active_license.json` |

---

## 7. localStorage keys (renderer-only)

| Key | Default | Purpose |
|-----|---------|---------|
| `neuralshell_internal_gtm_mode_v1` | off | Internal GTM / hollow surfaces |
| `neuralshell_runtime_role_v1` | `operator` | Role capabilities (`founder` = broadest) |
| `neuralshell_appliance_mode_v1` | off | Appliance mode flag |
| `neuralshell_airgap_mode_v1` | off | Air-gap locked UI |
| `neuralshell_demo_mode_v1` | off | Demo mode |

**No in-app toggle** was found for `internalGtmMode` — set via DevTools console (documented in `docs/patterns/hollow-surface-gating.md`).

---

## 8. IPC capability gates (examples)

Main returns `{ ok: false, reason: "tier_capability_required", required: "..." }` for e.g.:

- `proofRelay:setConfig` → `proof_relay_basic`
- `proofRelay:setRepoMap` → `proof_relay_map`

Renderer formats these via `src/renderer/src/lib/formatIpcTierMessage.js` and `UpgradeModal` / `TierGateNotice`.

---

## 9. Simplest way to unlock **everything** locally (without changing production defaults)

Use a **local-only** env file (not committed). Production/shipped builds keep default `auditor` or no file.

### Recommended: `NeuralShell.runtime.env` in repo root

Create `C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\NeuralShell.runtime.env`:

```env
LICENSE_MODE=enterprise
NS_ALLOW_DEV_LICENSE_KEY=1
```

Then `npm start` / `electron .` from that directory.

**What you get:**

- Full **enterprise** capability list from `config/tiers.json`
- `settings.tier` forced to **`OPERATOR`** (not audit-only)
- Proof relay / policy / enterprise modules unblocked at IPC layer
- Dev license signing if you also generate/activate a blob

**Why production stays safe:** file is local to your machine; installers still write `LICENSE_MODE=auditor`; repo defaults in `stateManager` remain `PREVIEW` / free.

### Optional extras (DevTools, after launch)

```javascript
// All internal GTM / hollow consoles
localStorage.setItem('neuralshell_internal_gtm_mode_v1', '1');

// Broadest role panel access
localStorage.setItem('neuralshell_runtime_role_v1', 'founder');
location.reload();
```

### Alternative: signed license (closer to production)

```bash
set NS_ALLOW_DEV_LICENSE_KEY=1
node scripts/generate_offline_license.cjs --plan=enterprise --output=dev-enterprise.license.json
```

Activate in **Settings → Billing & License**, or via `window.api.license.activateBlob(...)`.

E2E pattern: `e2e/billingActivation.spec.js` uses `NS_LICENSE_SIGNING_KEY=neuralshell-license-dev-signing-key-v1`.

### Test audit-only behavior

```env
LICENSE_MODE=auditor
```

Matches `e2e/auditor-mode.spec.js` — write controls disabled, proof commands still work.

---

## 10. Quick reference: modes vs outcomes

| `LICENSE_MODE` | `tierId` | Forced `settings.tier` | Audit-only UI |
|----------------|----------|------------------------|---------------|
| (unset) / `preview` | `free` (unless license blob) | `PREVIEW` | No |
| `auditor` | `free` | `AUDITOR` | **Yes** |
| `operator` | `pro` | `OPERATOR` | No |
| `enterprise` | `enterprise` | `OPERATOR` | No |

---

## 11. Gaps worth knowing

1. **Tier badge unlock ≠ full license** — use `LICENSE_MODE` or `license:activateBlob` for real capabilities.
2. **`settings.licenseMode` is not persisted** — env or license blob only for durable overrides.
3. **`NeuralShell.runtime.env` is not in `.gitignore`** — add it locally so you never commit dev unlocks.
4. **Internal GTM** is separate from billing tiers — only exposes hidden consoles, not commercial capabilities.

If you want this wired into a documented `npm run dev:unlocked` script, switch to Agent mode and that can be added without touching production install paths.
